en: A colorized vintage view of a landscaped park with flower beds, paths, and trees in the foreground. A gardener works on the lawn. In the background stands a large brick railway station with a central entrance, tall windows, and a small tower. People and a tram or trolley are visible in front of the station. At the bottom, there is printed text in Dutch reading "Nijmegen — Gezicht op Station."
